content: Specifically, one PNU is defined as being equivalent to 0.01 micrograms (µg) of protein nitrogen that is precipitable by phosphotungstic acid. Consequently, the results obtained from one manufacturer cannot be directly compared to those from another manufacturer due to variations in methodology. Given these limitations, the use of PNUs is gradually being phased out in favor of bioequivalent allergy units (BAU). BAUs are considered more reliable as they are determined through actual skin testing using standardized reference preparations of known potency.
